_comment: Simple Shell colour tokens (note 66). Read by tests/unit/designTokens.test.mjs (against src/index.css) and apps/ios/BanbeAppTests/DesignTokensTests.swift (against Palette). Contrast pairs are WCAG 2 ratios that must hold; alpha text is composited over its background first.
_blockComment: Note 66 follow-up: block = every card/tile/block on paper (light = surface2 #EEE8DA, dark = surface1 #1A1815 so dark mode is unchanged); blockInset = anything nested inside a block. honey text is checked on honeyOn only (honey on surface3 is 4.17:1 in light, never used as text there).
_matComment: Note 71 (Calm Pass phase 3): mat = the polaroid frame of a Home event card. It aliases an existing step (light surface1, dark surface2), so no new hue. In light it is only 1.04:1 against paper, so the card also gets a hairline and a soft ink-tinted shadow; dark separates by the surface step alone. matSlot = the empty photo slot inside the frame (light field, dark paper): the usual placeholder fill equals the dark mat and made the inset vanish. clay text is checked on clayOn only: light clay on block (#EEE8DA) is about 4.3:1, below AA, so clay must not be used as text on block fills.
_photoControlComment: Note 71 phase 4: the round controls over a cover photo (Event Detail back / more / share). Fixed in both themes. The white glyph is checked against the fill composited over the worst photos (white, black, mid grey, warm bright) with the sheen at its maximum.
